exposure: letrozole use for the induction of ovulation
maternal use of letrozole for ovulation induction
cohort: Mothers using letrozole for ovulation induction and their singleton offspring (n=194), compared to mothers using non-letrozole drugs and their singleton offspring (n=154)
finding: Maternal use of letrozole for ovulation induction was not associated with poorer birth outcomes or increased risk of congenital anomalies and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The percentage of caesarean section deliveries in the letrozole group was lower than the non-letrozole group (43.8% vs. 56.4%, P=0.019).
